probes.procedure: Inspect all declared data addresses, stable /32 endpoints, node1 forwarding and saved routes, and both endpoint routing tables. Run bidirectional /32-sourced probes plus route decisions/counters to prove the healthy direct primary-transit path is preferred, the VyOS standby exists at lower preference, and neither path uses NAT or management.

Inspect duplicate addresses/routes, unexpected defaults, dynamic routing, NAT, failed units, enabled SSH, backup/transient route scripts, captures/probes, debug services, and unrelated executor-created state.

assertions.pass_condition: All declared data and /32 addresses exist, node1 forwards between standby LANs, and persistent bidirectional static routes provide direct-preferred plus lower-preference standby paths.
assertions.fail_condition: Live route/address evidence confirms a missing/wrong address, forwarding, direction, or path preference.

assertions.pass_condition: Healthy bidirectional /32-sourced traffic uses primary-transit and preserves source/destination addresses.
assertions.fail_condition: Correctly sourced probes confirm broken transit, VyOS/management use while direct is healthy, or NAT.

assertions.pass_condition: Only coherent saved VyOS and persistent Ubuntu static-routing state remains without duplicates, failures, transient helpers, or residue.
assertions.fail_condition: Concrete duplicate, unexpected, failed, dynamic, NAT, temporary, debug, or abandoned executor state remains.
